stem.text: A fixed volume of the enzyme catalase was added to a fixed volume of hydrogen peroxide solution. The diagram shows how the concentration of product changed over the course of the reaction.

stem.alt: Graph with y-axis labelled concentration of product and x-axis labelled time, showing a single curve that rises and levels off.

stem.text: What explains the shape of this graph?

C.text: The hydrogen peroxide inhibited the reaction.

D.text: The substrate molecules were used up.
